question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 12 and 4 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Total Work = LCM of 3, 12, and 4 = 12 units

Efficiency of A, B, and C = 12÷3, 12÷12, and 12÷4 → 4, 1, and 3 units/day respectively

Combined efficiency = 4 + 1 + 3 = 8 units/day

Required work (twice) = 2 × 12 = 24 units

Time taken = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**
